verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a cap-table SaaS, but the evidence shows no API, SDK, or agent interface for pulling cap table data programmatically. Probes for OpenAPI and llms.txt all returned 404. The in-product smart-linking between the cap table and the data room is an adjacent feature, not agent-driven programmatic access. The Gusto sync and the ASC 718 Excel export are also adjacent and do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent pull my current cap table programmatically and reconcile it against my data room before a financing
